evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence?

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B).
